regressions.command: node scripts/harness.mjs bounded -- node --test --test-name-pattern='^target final review (refuses a nonconventional|names a 90-character|excludes merged subjects|names the described range)' scripts/test-target-worktree-start.mjs
cases: A nonconventional new commit refuses without a lifecycle event.
A 90-character new subject refuses at the existing 72-character limit.
Merged invalid subjects are excluded with the fetched ref present, even when origin is offline; the activation record is unchanged.
An absent fetched ref falls back to the activation range, names that fallback and refuses without a lifecycle event.
A new format violation names the described range, activation base and offending commit.
A new launchpad identifier is still refused with the same range context.
New AI attribution is still refused with the same range context.

limits: The real-worktree probe invokes the same lint function as final-review-result pass without recording that transition. Synthetic fixture tests exercise the result transition. Verification, final review and publication remain separate dispatches.
